newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas rises on Axa chairman comments.
newsitem.headline: Paribas rises on Axa chairman comments.

text.p: Shares in French holding company Paribas traded higher following comments published on Monday from Axa chairman Claude Bebear that Paribas's recovery was sustainable and he expected the stock to rise in 1997.
An equity salesman at a large French brokerage said the rise in Paribas shares was due to Bebear's comments in newspaper Le Monde.
Paribas was up 0.96 percent at 345.70 francs at 1126 GMT, after climbing nearly two percent.
Bebear told Le Monde that he thought Paribas' results would improve, and that the shares would rise once the markets saw that its recovery would be confirmed this year.
He also said Axa would not reduce its strategic holding in Paribas.
Axa holds 10.7 percent of Paribas following its merger with Union des Assurances de Paris announced late last year.
